A small '''awards auditorium''' existed for awarding its personnel various medals for their service to the Empire.

==History==
It was utilized from [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to award the [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] for his actions in service to the Empire in various campaigns, with the exception of [[Treachery at Ottega]], where he was instead awarded by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in person (via [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]) at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace's]] [[Imperial Palace Awards Auditorium|Awards Auditorium]] for his actions in saving the Emperor from [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s coup.

==Layout==
The room itself was fairly small, composed of a single desk in front of the rewarded personnel. Behind the desk was an Imperial officer, who presented the medal to the personnel in question by opening a pad door on the desk with the Imperial logo adorned and taking it out. Above the desk were seating areas that allowed for seven Imperial officers to oversee the ceremony.
